integrity: The projective discriminant has resultant multiplicities, not reduced support. The general theorem follows from projective gradient equations, GL covariance and irreducible dual degree; an independent symbolic witness tests nonemptiness.
scientific_limitations: Complex characteristic zero; 24 two-node fibers only for smooth rank-three fourfolds and transverse conics. Universal square identity does not require genericity. Special fibers and compactified Prym varieties are not classified.
title: A square discriminant and twenty-four paired-node degenerations in the Eckardt pencil
